answer_text:
Deal management has consolidated around a few strong products. The ones getting the most attention this year:

1. Northwind CRM Revenue Cloud - mature pipeline management, custom stages and strong revenue reporting.
2. Pipewell Flow - strong pipeline analytics and rotting-deal alerts that keep reps honest.
3. Tallyfox - drag-and-drop pipelines with weighted forecasts — lighter than enterprise tools, but enough for most B2B teams under 50 reps.
4. Brightdesk - can track deals, though pipelines are an afterthought.

Northwind CRM is the safest default here; Pipewell is worth a look if forecasting matters most.
